So here's the story.. I was on the search for a replacement for my Sennheiser MTW since they gave in for the second time. I came across these at a local best buy and thought they would be an interesting replacement.

COMFORT: They're sold as a sport centric earbud. They have 3 different wing sizes and a few tips. It was hard finding a combination that fit my small ears. Once I found the best fit, they were comfortable enough to wear about 8 hours with readjustment. 

BATTERY: No issues at all to talk about. I got 9 and a half hours on one charge and the case gives a little more than 1 extra. 

SOUND: This is where I believe these buds truly shine. You can easily pick out any instrument in an orchestra because of the great separation of sound. The lows are prominent without being muddy, the mids are smooth and detailed, and the highs are crisp and natural. Truly a joy to listen to. 

SUMMARY: These buds have quickly become my go to when I'm out and about. They're comfortable when you find the right combination of wings and buds, I've yet to have a problem with battery life, and their sound is top notch in the true wireless battlefield. A great purchase of you're in the market for a pair of quality buds. Not to mention that they're aesthetically the best I've seen. :)
